items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Justin Sun says Trons post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
items.summary: Were ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time, Sun said in a post on X.

items.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
items.summary: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
items.summary: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhiles Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.

items.title: US plans to seize $1B in crypto linked to Iran this week: Scott Bessent
items.summary: The Treasury Department has announced several digital asset seizures related to sanctions on Iran as part of US sanctions.

items.title: New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement
items.summary: The agreement resolves a 2023 civil fraud lawsuit against the Celsius founder and permanently bars him from the cryptocurrency, securities and commodities industries.

items.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
items.summary: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the swap definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gamblingsharpening the agencys claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

items.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
items.summary: Meanwhile, a Bermuda-based life insurer that denominates policies in bitcoin, raised $37.5 million in a round led by Bain Capital Crypto.

items.title: Heres a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
items.summary: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.

items.title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
items.summary: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budgets revenue section.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Quietly Rehearsing for the Day After an AI Catastrophe
items.summary: Executives are war-gaming the political fallout of a major AI-driven cyberattack and preparing to brief Congress fast if and when necessary.

items.title: Senate Democrat Presses Cantor Fitzgerald on Tether Ties and Lutnick Family Profits
items.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wants Cantor Fitzgerald to open its records on Tether and on how much Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnicks family has earned from its business deal.

items.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
items.summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last weeks trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

items.title: Former FTX COO says Netflixs Altruists trailer made me physically throw up
items.summary: Former FTX COO Constance Wang says Netflixs The Altruists misrepresents FTXs collapse and turns it into a love story.

items.title: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC greenlight for US prediction markets, crypto derivatives trading: CNBC
items.summary: Blockchain.com has applied for DCM and FCM licenses to offer ahead of a planned $500 million IPO.

items.title: Ledger investigates wallet drains involving CryptoBilis buyers; estimate tops $86 million in losses
items.summary: Ledger said it is investigating reports of fund losses from users in Southeast Asia who bought its products from reseller CryptoBilis.

items.title: US targets $1 billion Iran-linked crypto seizure, Bessent says we know where it is
items.summary: Bessents latest crypto seizure plan follows months of sanctions and freezes targeting Iranian assets.

items.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million from former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
items.summary: NY AG Letitia James secured up to $35M from ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky and a permanent ban from the securities and crypto industries.

items.title: Luxors reported 6-13% annualized Bitcoin yield depends on mining delivery
items.summary: Luxors paired forwards can fix gross BTC receipts, while mining delivery, counterparty performance and financing terms still determine repayment.

items.title: Coinbases Texas move gets a shareholder suit dismissed over Delaware-era claims
items.summary: The October 2 court order required a written board demand in this action, without deciding whether directors committed misconduct.

items.title: Bitcoins weekend rebound faces an $80,400 test after nearly $730 million in ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $82,900 in PerpFinders Oct. 10, 09:36 UTC snapshot, with traders watching whether the weekend rebound brings fresh leverage or further position unwinding.

items.title: Stealing $1.5B in crypto is easy, cashing out is the trap
items.summary: North Korean hackers stole around $1.5 billion from Bybit in February 2025. While the hack itself has been widely covered and analyzed, few have focused on what happened afterward.

items.title: Inflation target of 2% may not stop the next Fed rate freeze
items.summary: The Fed can stop raising rates before inflation reaches 2% if officials believe the economys already heading there without another increase.

items.title: Celsius founder faces lifetime ban, but can trade his own crypto
items.summary: A qualifying DOJ payment can satisfy the $25 million obligation, while a separate $10 million judgment has a sentence-completion condition with exceptions.

items.title: Bitcoin Life Insurer Meanwhile Raises $37.5M as Wealthy Families Look to Pass On Their BTC
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Life Insurer Meanwhile Raises $37.5M as Wealthy Families Look to Pass On Their BTC The Bermuda-regulated startup, whose backers include Bain Capital Crypto and Sam Altman, has now raised more than $180 million.

items.title: We Know Where It Is: Treasury Secretary Threatens To Freeze $1B of Irans Crypto
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine We Know Where It Is: Treasury Secretary Threatens To Freeze $1B of Irans Crypto The U.S. will seize $1 billion of Irans crypto this week, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said.

items.title: Heres How Not To Screw up Your Bitcoin Privacy
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Heres How Not To Screw up Your Bitcoin Privacy Speaking on the Bitcoin Rails podcast, Cake Wallets Seth for Privacy said people need to take more precautions to protect their identities.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $729M in Two Days as Investors Reverse Course
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin ETFs Shed $729M in Two Days as Investors Reverse Course Investors have fast cashed out of bitcoin exchange-traded funds this week.

items.title: Ledger Warns Buyers Not to Set Up Wallets From Reseller After Users Report Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ledger Warns Buyers Not to Set Up Wallets From Reseller After Users Report Losses Hardware wallet manufacturer Ledger is investigating after users reported having wallets drained.

items.title: UTXOs Loren Asmus: The $300T Bond Market Is Bitcoins Next Frontier
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine UTXOs Loren Asmus: The $300T Bond Market Is Bitcoins Next Frontier UTXO Managements Loren Asmus: Bitcoin isnt a trade, but a portfolio staple.

items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

items.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
items.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

items.title: Bitcoins $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
items.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

items.title: Bitcoins volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

items.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.
